meta.description: Grows gills under the cap and the partial veil that closes them off. A pattern around the stem marks the gills, tips on the cap underside grow down along it.

gill_count.description: Gills that reach from the margin to the stem

lamellulae.description: Short gills between two gills, they only reach halfway in

gill_depth.description: How far the gills reach down into the space under the cap

veil.description: The partial veil between cap margin and stem

veil_attachment.description: Where the veil meets the stem, 0 level with the cap margin, 1 at the top of the stem. The ring stays there when the veil tears.

max_segments.description: Upper limit for the added segments
